newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's completes sale to Dillard.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's completes sale to Dillard.

text.p: Retailer Proffitt's Inc said Monday it had completed the sale of seven Division stores in Virginia to Dillard Department Stores Inc.
Specific terms of the sale, which was announced in December, were not disclosed.

The stores sold are in Chesapeake Square and Greenbrier Mall in Chesapeake, Coliseum Mall in Hampton, Patrick Henry Mall in Newport News, Chesterfield Town Center and Virginia Center Commons in Richmond and Pembroke Mall in Virginia Beach, Proffitt's said.
Proffitt's Inc operates five divisions -- Proffitt's with 19 stores, McRae's with 29 stores, Younkers with 48 stores, Parisian with 39 stores and Herberger's with 39 stores.
The total company operates 174 stores in 24 states with annualized revenues of more than $2.3 billion.
